questions.question: How long must a new full-time employee wait before becoming eligible for remote work?
What hours must remote employees be online?
questions.reference_answer: 10:00 to 15:00 local time, Monday through Thursday.

questions.question: How much is the yearly equipment stipend, and when are receipts due?
questions.reference_answer: $600 per calendar year; itemized receipts are due within 30 days.

questions.question: Can a contractor work remotely under this policy?
questions.reference_answer: No. Contractors are not eligible for remote work.

questions.question: How many business days can someone work from another country in a year?
questions.reference_answer: No more than 20 business days per calendar year.

questions.question: What approval is needed before working abroad?
questions.reference_answer: Written approval from the manager and People Operations at least 30 days in advance.

questions.question: What is the hotel limit in Tier 1 cities?
I lost my phone. How quickly must I report it?
questions.reference_answer: Within 24 hours to the Security team.
